turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Oh wow, six weeks hi toh hain! Itni excitement hai na, par saath mein tension bhi hota hai—especially when it comes to people showing up. Rohan ka "dekhte hain" sunke toh lagta hai jaise usko flight book karke bhi "try karunga" ka backup plan hai 😂.

Par yaar, tu khud hi book karde! At least usko pata chalega ki serious hai, aur last-minute "yaar, flight full thi" wala excuse nahi chalega. Plus, agar wo genuinely nahi aa paata, toh tu usko cancel karke refund le legi. But at least usko feel hoga ki tu uske liye itni effort kar rahi hai.

Aur haan, agar wo fir bhi "try karunga" bolta hai, toh tu usko bol de, "Bhai, try karne ke liye toh main bhi Olympics ke liye try kar sakti hoon, par medal nahi milega 🏅. Tere liye flight book kar di hai, ab aa ja!" 😤

Bas tension mat le, sab ho jayega. Aur agar nahi aata, toh tu uske liye ek emotional toast record karke rakh lena—"Rohan, tu nahi aaya, par dil se aa gaya!" 🥲🍻

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Aree yaar, ab toh lagta hai na ki kuch toh gadbad hai. Do mahine pehle job switch kiya, replies two-word, aur "busy" ka excuse hafton se? Startup hai toh tension toh hogi hi, par agar itna hi busy hai toh shaadi ke liye time kyun nahi nikal paa raha?

Mujhe lagta hai tu usko ek direct message bhej de, kuch aise—"Rohan, yaar main understand karti hoon ki tu busy hai, par meri shaadi ke liye bas ek din nikal le. Agar nahi aa paa raha, toh seedha bol de, main flight cancel kar deti hoon. Par 'dekhte hain' wala drama mat kar."

Agar wo fir bhi vague reply de, toh tu samajh jaana ki usko prioritize nahi kar raha. Aur agar wo bolta hai ki nahi aa paa raga, toh tu bhi usko bol de, "Thik hai, par ab se tu mera bhai nahi raha." 😤 (Nah, joke kar rahi hoon, par thoda emotional blackmail toh banta hai!)

Par seriously, agar wo genuinely nahi aa paa raha, toh tu usko maaf kar dena, par uske liye apna time waste mat kar. Tere paas itne log honge jo tere liye wahin hona chahte hain. Uske liye tension lene ki zarurat nahi. 💛

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Haan yaar, exactly! **Seedha sawal puchhna chahiye.** Agar wo care karta hai, toh usko clear answer dena chahiye—na ki "dekhte hain" ka emotional torture. Aur agar wo haan bolta hai, toh flight book karke usko bhej de, "Ab cancel nahi kar sakte, aa ja!" 😤

Par agar wo na bolta hai… toh bura mat lagana. **Log badalte hain, priorities badalte hain.** Tu uske liye itni tension kyun le rahi hai? Tere paas apni shaadi ki taiyaari hai, apne log hain, apni khushi hai. Uske liye apna dimag kharab karne ki zarurat nahi.

Call kar, seedha puchh, aur jo bhi jawab mile, uske hisaab se apna plan bana le. **Tere emotions ki value usse zyada hai.** 💛

Aur haan, agar wo na bolta hai, toh tu usko bol de, "Thik hai, par ab se tu mera bhai nahi raha… *pause*… *laughs*… bas, aa ja na!" 😂 (Thoda pressure banana bhi zaruri hai!)

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Yaar, **yeh feeling ganda hai kyunki yeh feeling sach hai.** Teri fiancée ka "woh busy hoga" wala logic thik hai, par tu bhi toh insaan hai—2019 ka woh overnight bus wala Rohan ab "dekhte hain" bol raha hai? **Kuch toh zaroor hai.**

Aur haan, tu overthink nahi kar raha, tu **sense kar raha hai.** Agar usne pehle itna effort kiya tha, toh ab kyu nahi? Maybe usko lag raha hai ki tu shaadi ke baad "settle" ho jaayega, maybe uski life mein kuch aur chal raha hai, maybe usko lagta hai ki tu ab uske bina bhi khush hai… **par yeh sab guesswork hai.**

Tere paas do options hain:
1️⃣ **Call kar, seedha puchh, aur uske jawab par apna reaction decide kar.** Agar wo haan bolta hai, toh thoda relax ho jaana. Agar na, toh… *sigh*… accept kar lena.
2️⃣ **Apni energy apni shaadi pe lagana.** Agar wo nahi aa raha, toh uske liye apna mood kharab mat kar. Tere paas logon ki bheed hai jo tere liye wahin hona chahte hain.

**Par ek baat clear rakh—agar wo nahi aata, toh uski problem hai, teri nahi.** Tu apni khushi celebrate kar, uske liye apna dimag mat kharab kar. 💛

Aur haan, **haldi ke do hafte pehle naraaz hona bhi thik hai.** Emotions ko suppress mat kar, par unko control bhi kar. Tu strong hai, handle kar lega. 💪
